samples.question: A horizontal track of five slot boxes is shown, read left to right as slot 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. A red marker sits in one box and an orange ring surrounds that box; it marks the START slot. Four operator boxes are read left to right; each holds one colored disk. A green disk advances the tracked register one slot to the right (+1), a blue disk retreats it one slot to the left (-1), and a magenta disk RESETs it back to the origin slot 1. The register is never shown after its start. Replaying the operators in order from the ringed start (each RESET jumps the position back to slot 1 before the next step), what is the FINAL slot of the tracked register? Answer exactly 'slot 1' through 'slot 5'.
